meta.name: understand-dashboard
meta.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化代码库知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直观浏览代码库的结构和依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize your codebase's knowledge graph interactively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore your codebase's structure and dependencies visually.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会启动一个交互式网页仪表盘，展示当前项目的知识图谱。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 可视化项目的知识图谱时触发。

say.text: 启动仪表盘，查看当前项目的知识图谱。
say.note: Claude 会启动仪表盘并返回访问链接。

say.text: 帮我打开知识图谱仪表盘。
say.note: Claude 会检查知识图谱文件并启动仪表盘。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude launches an interactive web dashboard to visualize the knowledge graph of the current project.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to visualize the project's knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Launch the dashboard to view the project's knowledge graph.
say_en.note: Claude starts the dashboard and returns the access URL.

say_en.text: Open the knowledge graph dashboard for me.
say_en.note: Claude checks for the knowledge graph file and starts the dashboard.
